# Proof of concept — one clip, generated by hand

Two start frames, composed from the project's own assets by
`tools/make-poc-frames.py`:

  frame-01-empty-sheet.png      the opening state
  frame-03-plan-complete.png    the plan finished, before the walls rise

Hand `frame-01-empty-sheet.png` to Higgsfield as the image-to-video start
frame. It costs no prompt budget to establish the paper, and it removes the
largest source of drift — a generator inventing its own sheet, its own light
and its own plan.

The full generation spec, including the prompt, the settings and what to look
for in the result, is in ../higgsfield-poc.md.
